vulnerabilities.description: OverflowToken.transfer(address,uint256) (test_contracts/OverflowToken.sol#24-32) compiles under Solidity 0.7.x without SafeMath. balances[msg.sender] -= amount can underflow when the sender balance is below `amount`, wrapping to a huge value.
OverflowToken.mint(address,uint256) (test_contracts/OverflowToken.sol#38-42) can overflow totalSupply when the cumulative mint amount exceeds 2**256 - 1.

OverflowToken.approve(address,uint256) (test_contracts/OverflowToken.sol#48-53) allows allowance to be set without zeroing the previous value first - subject to the classic race-condition front-running.
Outdated compiler ^0.7.6 lacks SafeMath built-in; consider migrating to >=0.8.0 for automatic overflow checks.
